'''KU-Hehe''' is an KU-Roro Guard in [[Tethys Hub]], [[The Black Shores]]. They stand guard with [[KU-Haha]] and are a part of the ''[[Rover's Journey I]]'' [[trophy]]: ''[[Hehe Haha]]''.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|KU-Haha}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;'''KU-Haha''' No entry beyond this point. Please leave.
;'''KU-Hehe''' The emergency response team is clearing out abnormal frequency. 

;(Day)
:'''KU-Hehe:''' Stop dragging me! The binding code is gonna snap!
:'''KU-Haha:''' Just come over here and stand where Adrian told us! Even if you break, the code will hold!
:'''KU-Hehe:''' [[Adrian]] said to guard this area. It doesn't matter exactly where we stand. Don't get hung up on the details. Wait, someone's coming.
:'''KU-Hehe:''' Excuse me. No entry beyond this point. Please leave.
:{{DIcon}} What's going on?
::'''KU-Haha:''' The surface of the Black Shores has been invaded by abnormal frequencies, creating multiple data wormholes.
::'''KU-Hehe:''' The emergency response team is clearing the indoor area. No one is permitted to enter now.
:'''KU-Haha:''' Hey! I'm in charge here!
:'''KU-Hehe:''' What? I was just about to say that!
:{{DIcon}} Are you two arguing? 
::'''KU-Haha:''' Heh!
::'''KU-Hehe:''' Heh!
----
;(Night)
:'''KU-Haha:''' I saw that charging station first!
:'''KU-Hehe:''' But I've always used it!
:'''KU-Haha:''' Doesn't mean it's yours!
:{{DIcon}} What are you arguing about?
:'''KU-Hehe:''' This KU-Haha here stole my charging station and pretended it didn't! It even made the station explode!
:'''KU-Haha:''' It wouldn't have blown up if you hadn't barged in while it was running! And [[KU-HeeHee]] wouldn't have gotten hurt and needed factory repairs!
:{{DIcon}} Wait, your argument caused someone else to get hurt?
:'''KU-Hehe:''' I...
:'''KU-Haha:''' That was an accident...
:'''KU-Hehe:''' Adrian docked our allowances for it and told us to guard this room.
:'''KU-Hehe:''' He wanted us to learn to cooperate, so he input a code that binds us 24/7.
:{{DIcon}} So that's the reason.
:'''KU-Haha:''' But I can't stand being around this guy! Not for another second!
:{{DIcon}} ...Looks like you haven't learned the lesson.
{{Dialogue End}}
